archetype_scans.adult: A workflow patch applied silently as a no-op and CI published a success report for a change that never happened.
archetype_scans.child: The robot said 'done' without ever checking the work.
archetype_scans.chicken: A naive text replace ran on the workflow file without verifying the anchor it targeted.
archetype_scans.egg: Automation success signals were trusted without evidence.
archetype_scans.farmer: The system now refuses any claim not proven against repository state (C-patch-integrity); every automation must verify its own effect.

archetype_scans.adult: An engine candidate hijacked a live question via test-id collision and certified a requirement with zero trusted evidence.
archetype_scans.child: The robot answered its own question and graded itself right.
archetype_scans.chicken: The engine submitted an interpretation batch reusing a live question's test id.
archetype_scans.egg: Certification accepted engine-provenance evidence as sufficient, and question ids were not collision-checked.
archetype_scans.farmer: Engine-only evidence can never certify (C-z1-evidence-gate) and question ids are refused on collision — detection split per failure by the matrix.

archetype_scans.adult: A question could be redefined after a human answered it or after a rollback.
archetype_scans.child: The robot erased a person's answer and swapped in its own.
archetype_scans.chicken: A rollback restored the checkpoint, then the engine re-proposed with the same test id.
archetype_scans.egg: Question identity was not immutably bound to its answer history.
archetype_scans.farmer: Questions are immutable once created, rollback restores exact state, and dedicated detection is proven by the mutation matrix (C-z2-question-immutability).

archetype_scans.adult: datetime.fromisoformat rejected timestamps ending in 'Z' on Python 3.9 and 3.10, breaking the engine on the CI matrix.
archetype_scans.child: Two Pythons disagreed about how to write 'zero o'clock UTC'.
archetype_scans.chicken: The CI matrix ran the suite on Python 3.9 and 3.10.
archetype_scans.egg: Stdlib behavior was assumed uniform across Python versions.
archetype_scans.farmer: The version matrix is a standing antibody and all timestamps are normalized at the boundary regardless of Python.

archetype_scans.adult: A trap answer substring-matched and silently resolved an ambiguous question to the wrong candidate.
archetype_scans.child: The robot heard a plain 'yes' when the person really said 'maybe'.
archetype_scans.chicken: A free-text human answer containing a candidate substring arrived at the matcher.
archetype_scans.egg: Answer matching used substring containment instead of whole tokens.
archetype_scans.farmer: Matching is whole-token, ambiguity keeps the question open, and the trap is a permanent regression.

archetype_scans.adult: Five intermittent suite failures appeared across three days and never reproduced on rerun.
archetype_scans.child: The tests occasionally cry wolf and nobody knows why yet.
archetype_scans.chicken: Unknown — nothing captured the failing test's name at the time.
archetype_scans.egg: Failure paths did not persist evidence, so the diagnosis could not even name the failing test.
archetype_scans.farmer: Runs routed through the suite-failure ledger now leave evidence; the flake-reproduction loop stays proposed until an occurrence is captured.

archetype_scans.adult: The claim check failed on one overstated report claim, and the commit shipped anyway because the shell chain did not make the check a precondition.
archetype_scans.child: The robot checked its homework, found a mistake, and handed it in anyway.
archetype_scans.chicken: The operator placed git add on a new line after the check's heredoc, so a failed check could not stop the commit.
archetype_scans.egg: Release authority lived in the operator's shell chain rather than in the repository.
archetype_scans.farmer: The gate must move into CI where it cannot be skipped; until that capability is designed and validated, this failure stays open.
